_comment: One crawler policy, read by two places that must never disagree:
src/app/robots.tsx (advisory — a request, obeyed only by crawlers that choose to)
and scripts/cf-setup.mjs (enforcement — WAF rules at the Cloudflare edge).
Splitting them is how a site ends up inviting a crawler in robots.txt while
blocking it at the edge, which is invisible until the traffic never arrives.
The lists below are HTTP user-agent substrings, matched case-sensitively by
Cloudflare's `http.user_agent contains` and emitted verbatim as robots.txt
